What's here: the Canadian Digital Service's expert-curated, per-department canada.ca answer guidance
(`scenarios/context-<dept>/`), department lists (EN/FR), citation + safety + PII prompt guidance, and the
system card. Ask Canada's Canada pack uses these as grounding knowledge (`src/countries/ca/knowledge`) and as
a fact source for widget builders. Kept verbatim; adaptations live in the pack, not here.
